@graph.name: World Refugee Day, celebrated on June 20, is a date established by the United Nations (UN) to honor the strength, courage and resilience of the millions of people who were forced to leave their countries of origin due to armed conflicts, political, religious, ethnic persecution or serious violations of human rights
